review.algorithm_assessment: Exact planar arrangement: split every segment at rational intersections, sort outgoing halfedges by integer direction crossproducts, and walk left faces. Positive-area cycles bound finite faces; negative or zero-area boundary walks belong to the smallest enclosing positivecycle (or exterior), located at an exact infinitesimal left offset. This handles disjoint/nested components and dangling segments, not just connected arrangements. Build unit-cost dual edges for crossedwirepieces and BFS between locatedstart/endfaces. Fraction coordinates avoid floating topology errors; offset1e-60 is below separation bounds from integer coordinates<1e5 and intersection determinants<8e10. Text explicitly permits curvedwire and forbids crossingsatwireintersections; illustrative image adds no missingrule. Verify grid-embedded wire arrangements with independent discrete0/1BFS plus nested polygons and publishedsamples.
